expectations.text: Keeps one resource per API service and prefers many small resources over one holding a whole account.
expectations.evidence: The proposed v1 scope splits the API into separate, focused resources: marrowgate_workspace, marrowgate_workspace_member, marrowgate_template, marrowgate_segment and marrowgate_account_sending_domain. It turns down inline members in favor of a standalone workspace_member resource, so each resource owns its data alone. It also turns the sending domain into its own narrow singleton instead of folding it into a broader account resource.
